decision_rule: No mechanistic interpretation when sequence identity, integrity or comparable abundance is not verified.

decision_rule: G23W must increase direct MDM2 association in at least two orthogonal formats to reach the binding-causal tier.
orthogonal_confirmation: co-association assay plus an independent binding or proximity format
failure_action: Do not claim W23G-mediated loss of MDM2 binding.

decision_rule: A turnover change strengthens a regulatory-causal claim, but no change is inconclusive because p53-R9 lacks the predominant C-terminal p53 ubiquitination sites.
orthogonal_confirmation: ubiquitination plus stability or localization; verify assay performance with full-length canonical elephant TP53
failure_action: Do not reject binding-causal evidence solely because p53-R9 turnover is unchanged.

decision_rule: Retrogene-specific mechanism requires a p53-R9 residual beyond matched truncation controls.

critical_comparison: C4 versus C5 and C4/C5 versus C2/C3
decision_rule: Determine whether MDM2 reversion changes the Bax-linked mitochondrial pathway.
failure_action: Do not infer apoptosis mechanism from caspase signal alone.

decision_rule: The phenotype-causal tier requires a reproducible abundance-adjusted WT/G23W difference not fully reproduced by matched truncation controls.
normalization: construct abundance and viable cell count
orthogonal_confirmation: caspase readout plus an independent apoptosis measure
failure_action: Retain only the lower supported claim tier.

decision_rule: Guardian support requires interaction plus a consequence for canonical TP53 turnover or signaling.
orthogonal_confirmation: interaction plus canonical-TP53 ubiquitination/stability or response-element signaling
failure_action: Do not promote guardian mechanism from interaction alone.
